rules.title: Centralize navigation compatibility
rules.applies_when: Navigation bars, titles, actions, sheets, or back presentation change.
rules.evidence: Existing design-system search, shared appearance implementation, and representative screens.
rules.exceptions: A project contract proving the screen uses an independent navigation system.
rules.decision_limit: Do not prescribe a per-screen patch when the project has a shared appearance layer.

rules.title: Preserve native back behavior
rules.applies_when: A pushed destination or back presentation changes.
rules.evidence: Back tap, localized accessibility, and interactive edge-swipe results.
rules.exceptions: None unless the product explicitly replaces native navigation in an approved contract.
rules.decision_limit: Do not accept a visually similar custom back button as equivalent evidence.

rules.title: Separate pre-iOS-26 overrides from iOS 26 native behavior
rules.applies_when: The minimum supported iOS version is below 26.
rules.evidence: Availability guards plus evidence from the minimum supported runtime and iOS 26 or later.
rules.exceptions: Not applicable when the declared minimum supported version is 26 or later.
rules.decision_limit: Do not claim Liquid Glass or legacy compatibility from source inspection alone.

rules.title: Use project semantic colors and declared presentation policies
rules.evidence: Design tokens, supported locales, light/dark policy, and screenshots.
rules.exceptions: A project contract may intentionally lock one appearance or locale.
rules.decision_limit: Do not copy another project's colors as a compatibility fix.

rules.title: Require runtime evidence for interaction claims
rules.applies_when: A review claims navigation, scrolling, sheet, or state behavior works.
rules.evidence: Passing registered XCUITest scenarios and exported xcresult attachments.
rules.exceptions: None for a passing UI verdict.
rules.decision_limit: A screenshot alone cannot prove an interaction.
